Zygarde has a rather unique form change. First, you can switch Zygarde between the two forms, 10% Forme and 50% Forme using the Zygarde Cube. Plus, if it has the ability Power Construct, both of those forms will turn into Complete Forme when their Hit Points are less than 50% of standard if it has the Power Construct ability.
